Explore Loan Services

For Applicants

Everything You Need Before You Apply

Published eligibility criteria, plain application guidance and where to go next — no guesswork, no invented requirements.

Minimum age18 years
Maximum age65 years
Group size (microcredit)5–25 members
Group officers requiredChairman, Secretary, Treasurer

Application Guidance

Four Steps to Your Application

  1. 1

    Review the published criteria

    Check the eligibility requirements published for each MASLOC service — microcredit (group), small and project loans, and vehicle and equipment hire purchase.

  2. 2

    Prepare your business or group

    Groups should be 5–25 members with leaders (Chairman, Secretary, Treasurer) and internal rules. Individual applicants should be ready to describe an ongoing or viable start-up venture.

  3. 3

    Visit a MASLOC office

    MASLOC publishes that the full range of eligibility criteria and application guidance is available at every regional office and the Accra Head Office.

  4. 4

    Complete your application on site

    Office staff will confirm required documents, current terms and processing expectations for your facility — none of which are published online today.

Published Criteria by Service

Each MASLOC service publishes its own criteria. Review them before visiting an office:

Microcredit (Group Loans)

Groups of 5–25 members; members aged 18–65; a Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer; internal rules and a common production or operational interest.

Full criteria

Small & Project Loans

Aged 18–65, an ongoing business venture or project, sound knowledge and experience; start-ups must be viable and capable of generating employment.

Full criteria

Vehicle & Equipment Hire Purchase

Aged 18–65 with an ongoing venture; start-ups must be viable and employment-generating; full criteria available at MASLOC offices.

Full criteria

Wholesale Lending

For microfinance institutions on-lending to small businesses; terms are set by MASLOC and available from the Head Office.

Full criteria

Why some details are not published here

MASLOC's official website does not currently publish interest rates, loan amounts, repayment terms, approval timelines or a required-documents checklist. This site does not invent them. Contact a regional office or the Head Office for current, authoritative terms.
